title: Benchmark Cathode Market Update
gist: Member-only Benchmark Week 2026 video page for Head of Research Iola Hughes' cathode market update (Nov 10, 2026). No transcript; the agenda line says it covers cathode and precursor capacity growth in Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, regional pricing arbitrage, and which producers lead global expansion.

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's cathode market update highlights cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe.
insights.speaker: Iola Hughes, Head of Research, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Cathode and precursor capacity is spreading outside China to Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, which matters for tariff-compliant supply and regional winners.
insights.quote: Cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe

insights.claim: Benchmark's cathode market update identifies regional pricing arbitrage in cathode materials as a topic, which implies cathode prices differ meaningfully by region.
insights.speaker: Iola Hughes, Head of Research, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Price gaps between regions can shape where cathode makers sell and where buyers source.

insights.claim: Iola Hughes' cathode market update at Benchmark Week 2026 is member-only, and the page does not name which producers are leading global cathode expansion.
insights.speaker: Iola Hughes, Head of Research, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Producer rankings and capacity figures are behind the paywall; this card holds only the agenda.

source_meta.author: Iola Hughes, Head of Research, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
